title: River floods in the {region}
body: Rivers have burst their banks across the {region}. Villages are cut off and thousands have moved to relief camps.

choices.label: Deploy the national disaster response force
choices.description: Costs ₹2,500 cr; trained teams cut the damage sharply.
choices.outcome: Response teams reach the {region} quickly. The damage is far lower than it could have been.

choices.label: Request army assistance
choices.description: Costs ₹1,500 cr; fast on the ground, less specialised.
choices.outcome: Soldiers reach the {region} within hours. Rescue is fast, though recovery is patchy.

choices.label: Announce a large relief package
choices.description: Costs ₹7,500 cr; goodwill and rebuilding funds.
choices.outcome: A generous relief package is announced for the {region}. Anger turns into gratitude.

choices.label: Leave it to the state government
choices.description: No cost; the full damage lands.
choices.outcome: The central government stays out. Anger builds in the {region}.

title: Disease outbreak in the {region}
body: Doctors in the {region} report a fast-spreading infection. Clinics are overflowing and neighbouring districts are on alert.

choices.label: Launch an emergency vaccination drive
choices.description: Costs ₹6,000 cr; the Health ministry contains the outbreak.
choices.outcome: Teams vaccinate door to door. The outbreak is contained within weeks.

choices.label: Impose movement restrictions
choices.description: Costs ₹1,500 cr; slows the spread but hurts business.
choices.outcome: Restrictions slow the spread, but shops and factories pay for it.

choices.label: Monitor and wait
choices.description: No cost; the outbreak spreads.
choices.outcome: The outbreak spreads across the region before it is brought under control.

title: Fever season overwhelms hospitals in the {region}
body: Mosquito-borne fevers are surging after the rains. Hospitals in the {region} have run out of beds.

choices.label: Fund fogging and testing camps
choices.description: Costs ₹900 cr; the Health ministry limits the damage.
choices.outcome: Camps and fogging drives bring cases down within a fortnight.

choices.label: Leave it to local hospitals
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: Hospitals cope as best they can. Families blame the government.

title: Rebuilding the {region}
body: Weeks after the disaster, the {region} needs money to rebuild homes, roads and schools. Local leaders are asking for central funds.

choices.label: Fund full reconstruction
choices.description: Costs ₹4,000 cr; rebuilds and calms the region.
choices.outcome: Homes, roads and schools go up again. The {region} remembers who helped.

choices.label: Offer soft loans
choices.description: Costs ₹1,200 cr; partial help.
choices.outcome: Soft loans help the {region} slowly rebuild.

choices.label: Leave it to the state
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: The state is left to cope on its own.

title: Relief supplies diverted in the {region}
body: Reports say relief grain and blankets meant for the {region} were sold in the open market. Survivors are furious.

choices.label: Order an immediate probe
choices.description: Costs ₹400 cr; shows you care.
choices.outcome: The probe nets a handful of officials. The anger fades.

choices.label: Deny and move on
choices.description: No cost; the story grows.
choices.outcome: The denials ring hollow and the story grows.

title: Foreign governments offer disaster aid
body: Friendly governments have offered money and teams to help with recovery in the {region}.

choices.label: Accept the aid
choices.description: Brings ₹3,000 cr and goodwill.
choices.outcome: The aid arrives and is put to work quickly.

choices.label: Decline with thanks
choices.description: Self-reliance plays well at home.
choices.outcome: You thank them and decline. Many voters approve of the self-reliance.
